Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As promised, here’s a short playbook that lays out how we plan to warmstart FathomSearch’s index and run the first rerank acceptance gate so your search experience stays stable during the migration. High level goals: get a seeded vector index that covers top user journeys, verify rerank improves relevance on your core queries, and avoid visible regressions.

Attachments: warmstart_sample_set.csv (sample queries + golden hits) — this is the sample we discussed.

Planned timeline (initial):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm sample set & access, finalize vectorstore choice (you asked about Milvus vs managed vectorDB)
- Week 1: index small warmstart (50k docs), smoke rerank eval on sample set, quick ops runbook
- Week 2–3: phased backfill to full index with batching + KV cache tuning, rerank A/B test on a slice of traffic

Key decisions we need from you:
1) Vector DB: managed (VectorCloud) vs self-managed Milvus? (ops + SLA tradeoffs)
2) Acceptable latency SLO for search path (p95 token latency target)
3) Any privacy/data-retention constraints we should enforce during priming/backfill

I'll loop in Marissa and Ben (CS and Implementation) — they'll own the cadence of the backfill and rerank evals. If this looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff and share an eval matrix.

Thanks Priyom — this looks helpful. A few quick answers: 
- We prefer managed VectorCloud; we don't have infra bandwidth to run Milvus right now.
- Latency target: p95 end-to-end search latency <= 350ms (for logged-in users), goal 250ms.
- Data retention: must purge staging priming artifacts after 30 days, and no raw PII is allowed in any shared sample sets.

I'll redline the sample set for PII, and share a short access grant for VectorCloud. Please flag anything that needs legal review (SLA/contract amendment).

Folks — copying a concrete ops plan we can hand off to the implementation run (short checklist + owners). I attached evaluation_matrix.xlsx with acceptance criteria and sampling buckets.

Implementation checklist (owners & quick notes):
1) Access & infra (Ben) — Confirm VectorCloud credentials, set up project, ensure throughput tier matches backfill plan (estimate: 2–3 vCPU per worker, request quota increase now).
2) Sample sanitization (Priyom) — Remove PII from warmstart_sample_set.csv and create a masked version for evaluation runs.
3) Warmstart seed (Marissa) — Backfill 50k warmstart docs to a dedicated index, instrument prefix caching for common user queries. Smoke tests: top-50 queries should return expected golden hits.
4) Rerank eval (Marissa + Priyom) — Run A/B on sample set: metrics = MRR@10, Recall@10, and human QA pass rate (80% or better to pass gate).
5) Phased backfill (Ben) — Plan 4 waves: 50k -> 250k -> 1M -> full. Each wave has a rollback checkpoint and score drift threshold.
6) Post-cutover monitoring (Marissa) — Dashboard: token cost, p95 latency, rerank delta, user-reported regressions.

Acceptance thresholds (from evaluation_matrix.xlsx):
- MRR@10 delta (new vs baseline) >= +0.03 or non-inferior within -0.01 with human QA pass rate >= 80%
- Rerank latency overhead <= 60ms median

Ben, can you confirm VectorCloud quota is available? Priyom, can you prepare a masked sample set before EOD Mon? Liam — we’ll mark any legal asks for the contract_amendment_v2.pdf referenced below.

Thanks,

Operational notes & vector DB considerations (summary for Ben & Liam):
- Document keys: use stable source_id + version tag; avoid using autogenerated DB ids as primary.
- Chunking: for long docs we will chunk at paragraph boundaries, attach parent_id in metadata to allow coarse retrieval + rerank context reconstruction.
- Embedding quantization: recommend fp16 or int8 QAT for VectorCloud; we'll measure quality delta on the warmstart sample.
- Backfill throughput: prefer batched writes of 5k docs per job with parallelism 4 — reduces indexing overhead and allows quick rollback by wave.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for the top 200 queries to eliminate cold-start noise during evaluation.

Immediate asks (owners & dates):
- Ben: confirm VectorCloud quota and create project (2026-11-30 09:00 PT).
- Priyom: upload masked warmstart_sample_set.csv and trimmed evaluation matrix (2026-11-30 17:00 PT).
